paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: QND magnon detection with a superconducting qubit coupled to a YIG sphere Kittel mode; reanalysis of Lachance-Quirion et al. 2017 data. Measured 95% CL upper limit g_aee < 2.6e-6 over 33.117-33.130 ueV, encoded as a flat bound across the stated mass range. Appendix notes a less conservative velocity-averaged treatment (<vtot sin theta> = 338 km/s) would give g_aee < 1.6e-7, but the quoted headline limit 2.6e-6 is used. Paper also mentions a future-sensitivity projection ~1e-8, not included here. Assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
